Brief: eSIM plan picker for a GCC travel app: pick a destination data plan, compare GB and days, buy (mobile)
Direction: Gas Station Price Sign
Direction spec:
typography: Big Shoulders for display at 34px, Archivo for body at 17px; Arabic in Reem Kufi and IBM Plex Sans Arabic at the same sizes, right to left.
typeVoice: condensed
color: Palette from Gas Station Price Sign: surface #121417, ink #F4F1E8, accent #E23A2C, support #F2B632; ship pairs #F4F1E8 on #121417, #F2B632 on #121417; text at 4.5 to 1 or more.
layout: Gas Station Price Sign runs the eSIM plan picker across the plan cards, the destination and coverage and the networks, speed and plan details on a 4 column grid with 16px margins and actions in the thumb zone. The main task, pick a destination data plan, compare GB and days, buy, now runs through the plan cards: plan is a tall price tile, big price in white, best plan in red. Destination and coverage: hero is one tall lightbox panel with a huge stacked number and small label. Networks, speed and plan details: each row is a slim lit tile with a label and a right-aligned number. Must keep: clear price, one primary action.
imagery: Night photos of real roadside pylons, cropped tight on the number tiles, high contrast with the glow kept and the brand areas blurred out.
motion: Slots in 280ms; with reduced motion on, The new number swaps in instantly with no slide.
texture: Pecked cup marks as slightly uneven inset circles with a 1 px inner shadow, in two parallel rows, on one progress or stats card only. The current mark fills with low sun amber. (from Qatari Al Jassasiya Rock Carvings); text sits on solid panels, never on the texture.
iconography: Line icons with small corner radius, 1.5px stroke, 24pt in the tab bar.
density: Balanced; one idea per screen, 44pt tap targets, generous spacing on an 8pt rhythm.
signature: Plan is a tall price tile, big price in white, best plan in red.
pattern: Gas Station Price Sign on the plan cards: Price unit switcher.
whyItFits: Stacked lit prices per data plan.
